hero.title: Grow Strong. Play Fearless.
hero.subtitle: Basketball training for ages 6–18, boys & girls, at MS Sports Arena BSD. Real fundamentals, a fun atmosphere, a team that feels like family.

about.title: More than basketball
about.body1: Bunny Ballers is a youth basketball club in BSD. We believe basketball isn't only about scoring — it's about discipline, teamwork, and the courage to make decisions under pressure.
about.body2: Every session is structured: warm-up and footwork, fundamental drills (dribbling, passing, shooting), then game situations and scrimmages. Younger kids learn through play, while older players are sharpened for competition and sparring games.

fundamentals.title: Fundamentals First
fundamentals.body: Correct basics from day one, so there are no bad habits to undo later.

family.title: A Team That Feels Like Family
family.body: A supportive room where new players find friends, not rivals.

ready.title: Game Ready
ready.body: Regular sparring and competition to test what we train.

programs.title: Pick the lane for their age
programs.subtitle: One club, three training tempos. Boys and girls train together.

schedule.title: Two sessions. One court.
schedule.note: Schedule may change during public holidays or tournaments. Latest updates are always posted on Instagram.

desire.text: Every session is structured: warm-up and footwork, fundamental drills, then game situations and scrimmages. Younger kids learn through play. Older players are sharpened for competition.

gallery.title: Inside the gym
gallery.subtitle: Sweat, laughter, and clutch shots. This is a normal week at Bunny Ballers.

beginner.q: My child has never played basketball. Can they join?
beginner.a: Absolutely. Most kids start from zero. Coaches group by age and ability.

gear.a: Sports shoes, training clothes, a water bottle, and a small towel. Balls are provided.

trial.q: Is there a trial before registering?
trial.a: Yes. The first trial is free, one session. After that our team will follow up on WhatsApp.

parents.q: Can parents wait at the venue?
parents.a: Yes. Parents may wait at the tribune or court side during the session.

makeup.q: What if my child cannot attend?
makeup.a: They can make up the other session in the same week: Friday 18:00 or Saturday 10:00.

compete.a: Yes. The team regularly plays sparring and inter-club games — you can see it on Instagram.

register.title: Come try your first session
register.subtitle: Fill in the form and our team will reach you on WhatsApp to arrange a trial.
register.ticketNote: Use the form on the left, or message Felix directly if that is faster.
register.consent: I agree this information may be used for Bunny Ballers registration purposes.
register.messageIntro: Hi Bunny Ballers! I would like to register my child for a trial.

legal.privacyBody: The trial form is only used to arrange a session on WhatsApp. This site does not store form data on a server. The chat continues on Felix's phone as the club contact.
legal.termsBody: The first trial is free, one session. The schedule may change on holidays or tournament days. Parents remain responsible for their child outside training time.

footer.dataNote: Form data is only used to arrange a trial.
